translations.en: In any case, the seal is still barely holding.
So we must do everything we can to protect it,
then either create a new seal or defeat that demon god.
Whichever it is,
I think we'll have to do one or the other...
Honestly, I'd prefer to settle this with a new seal.
As for the newly discovered town ruins,
we've learned that the place was called the @6rBahelmeja District@0r.
Does that answer your questions?
For now, I'd like you to keep in regular contact.
As long as you're alive,
I intend to keep you working properly.
Was there any information about the sealed demon god?
When you asked, @7rBeatrix@0r shook her head regretfully.
Unfortunately, I have no information
about exactly what sort of demon god is sealed away.
My adoptive father doesn't seem to know either...
This is only speculation, but perhaps "demon god"
was a name chosen to make it easier for people to understand,
and something else entirely is sealed away.
Its threat was equal to a demon god's, so @7rChu Lu Gah@0r
simply explained it that way.
That would explain why no specific details
survive in the legends. So we'll have to search for @7rChu Lu Gah@0r's research
from here on.
If anything comes up, I'll post a job to have it investigated.
I'm counting on you when that happens. And if you find anything important,
please tell me.
While we're on the subject, the light that made us think the seal had broken
is still a mystery too.
At present, it hasn't caused any actual harm.
Of course, something may happen later,
but so far we've seen no effects from that light.
I don't know whether the light caused it,
but the ruins of another town have been found.
They were discovered around the time that seal broke,
so I think there must be some connection...
We've learned, at least, that it was called the @6rBahelmeja District@0r.
That's all for now. Since it's unexplored territory,
I think it will be worth investigating all sorts of things there.
She was as demanding as ever.
Despite that thought, you nodded to her.
The fact that @7rChu Lu Gah@0r's seal was beginning to break
posed a grave problem that had to be solved.
It might be inappropriate in the face of such a serious crisis,
but feeling your heart race at the thought of what was to come
was part of being an adventurer.
Well, what would begin next?
Hoping for a job that would help resolve the crisis,
you settled into a seat at the tavern counter.
Welcome...
